strings.name: Tobias Lütke
strings.summary: After a German programming apprenticeship, Lütke turned software for a snowboard shop into Shopify with his partners. CEO since 2008, he expanded merchant software, payments and developer services, but also oversaw a logistics retreat and layoffs. In 2025–26 he promoted workplace AI and agent commerce. Public accounts disagree on whether he was born in 1980 or 1981.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Cofounded Shopify, helping smaller merchants build online stores and influencing commerce software and entrepreneurial ecosystems.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Koblenz, Germany; sources report either 1980 or 1981 as his birth year.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Entered a programming apprenticeship at 16 at BOG Koblenz, a Siemens-affiliated company.
strings.highlights.h1.title: From shop software to platform
strings.highlights.h1.text: Turned tools for his own store into Shopify’s merchant platform.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Founder control and restructuring
strings.highlights.h2.text: Received special Founder-share voting arrangements and restructured logistics and staffing in 2023.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Discussed agent commerce
strings.timeline.t1.text: An original Toronto interview explored AI shopping agents, business models and founder control.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Published AI expectations
strings.timeline.t2.text: Shared an internal memo making AI use a baseline and requiring teams to assess tools before requesting more staff.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Announced restructuring and logistics sale
strings.timeline.t3.text: A staff letter announced about 20% workforce reductions and a planned logistics sale to Flexport.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Founder-share arrangement implemented
strings.timeline.t4.text: A special share structure maintained his combined voting power at approximately 40%.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Shares began trading
strings.timeline.t5.text: Shopify listed in New York and Toronto, entering public capital markets.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Became CEO
strings.timeline.t6.text: Moved from chief technology officer to CEO, continuing product and organizational development.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Shopify platform launched
strings.timeline.t7.text: The team turned its early store technology into commerce software for other merchants.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Early business cofounded
strings.timeline.t8.text: Started with partners through Snowdevil’s snowboard shop and cofounded the company in September.

authorshipReview.scope: Original complete AI composition and field-by-field semantic review against Chinese; no human or native-language certification.
